method: CPU 8 read-only extraction and integer endpoint arithmetic over existing JSON and diagnostic-build receipts. No build, test, profiling, workload or file hashing was run. Stored identity strings are copied from existing receipts and were not freshly byte-verified in this extraction.
scope: Six independently instrumented 15-second C1 persistent-session single-case observations. Numeric requests 32 rows with batch size 32. Transactions use the mixed consumer transaction cases; requested prepared mode does not imply a prepared overload for every CRUD method. No single-row/100-row/1000-row phase or 30-minute mixed counts are inferred.
counter_semantics: Calls count wrapped managed-to-native Korda ABI invocations, including release calls; they are not distinct owner allocations or network messages. Native-to-managed notifications, internal libpq/sqlite calls and diagnostic counter reads are excluded. SqlExecutions names actual provider dispatches, including controls, not confirmed successful server statements. ProtocolSubmissions counts successful libpq send/Sync API calls, not required replies, packets or RTT. Polls and NW_PENDING are not mandatory replies.

parameters.Scheduling: closed-loop; next operation planned after preceding completion; no external arrival rate
